Heads up: this course is a replay of the live Breakthrough Program, so you’ll hear me mention the group chat. If you’d like to join the next live round or 1:1 program, email me at savannah@colourmeneurospicy.com.au. There’s a discount because you’ve already invested in the self-paced course.

For now, keep watching!

If you were going to start taking responsibility for having a well-oiled machine (brain, body, mind and nervous system), what would need to change in your day-to-day life to keep the cogs turning well?

You don’t need to take action on them all. What could you easily change today and commit to doing every day? Eating lunch? Drinking at least one bottle of water? Regulating your nervous system before bed? A short walk instead of scrolling?
